content.title: The Harmonic Seal
content.description: Match the target chord by pulsing a sigil and each direct neighbour.

responsive_evidence.visual_review: PASS; complete current and target boards remain simultaneously legible, essential controls are unclipped, and no horizontal overflow is present.
responsive_evidence.touch_disposition: PASS with a recorded residual caveat: 35.27px short-landscape cells are below the site's common 44px convention but exceed WCAG 2.2 Target Size Minimum of 24px, retain spacing, and passed pointer activation.

residual_risks: The 568x320 layout necessarily uses 35.27px cells; future device testing may still motivate a larger-target layout despite passing the specified gate.
Initial positive playtesting came from a small family sample and is qualitative, not representative product research.
Automated accessibility checks do not replace testing with multiple real screen readers and mobile assistive technologies.

acceptance_disposition.evidence: One modal shell, sibling views, one backdrop and one focus trap.
Back switches in place; close paths and exact invoker focus return pass.
View/close preserve document memory; reload resets; no durable storage exists.
Center, edge, corner, and double-pulse masks pass.
Exact boards solve after documented 2, 3, 4, and 5 pulses.
Learned state survives double center pulse and undo-to-origin; restart restores guide.
Completion blocks pulses and exposes explicit progression without move pressure.
More-than-25 undo and exact folio/session reset scopes pass.
Reflection is explicit, local, correctly preserved/reset, and never transmitted.
Five rows, 25 named buttons, roving tabindex, bounded keys, and input parity pass.
Focus containment, inertness, status behavior, restoration, and axe pass.
Full-viewport layouts, scroll lock, safe-area CSS, bounds, touch geometry, and activation pass.
Eight reviewed screenshots retain both complete patterns and controls in one viewport.
Reduced-motion and non-color feedback pass; every target exposes a synchronized 25-state row description.
JS-disabled browser reports hidden=true/display=none/width=0/height=0; build, static, navigation, and non-home checks pass.
Declared boundaries and prohibited-capability scan pass with no new runtime dependency.
